They introduced WoW (World-Omniscient World Model), an embodied world model that enables robots to truly "see, understand, and act in the world," helping embodied intelligent robots quickly learn and master various skills and supporting the industry in creating the "most user-friendly" robots. On October 14, 2025, NetEase CodeWave held a communication event themed "Reconstructing Development Methods with AI," officially launching multiple intelligent development capabilities that support the full lifecycle of research and development, including requirement analysis, product conception, development deployment, and iteration. As a development platform for enterprise R&D scenarios, NetEase CodeWave integrates visual and AI-driven approaches, enabling every step to be automated by AI while allowing manual layout and fine-tuning, thereby creating a more controllable, standardized, and practical intelligent development model.

Several core AI capabilities were newly released, covering the entire application development lifecycle. These include generating pages from PSD design drafts, intelligent product design, automated application generation, and smart asset creation and integration, spanning the complete process from idea conception, requirement definition, prototype design, and application development to continuous iteration. This not only significantly enhances development efficiency and experience but also breaks down technical barriers, enabling non-technical staff such as product managers and operations personnel to deeply participate in development collaboration, achieving a standardized and harmonious model.

In product design scenarios, with just a simple and clear requirement description, the CodeWave intelligent product design assistant facilitates the entire process from idea to implementation and from ambiguity to clarity through multi-turn human-machine dialogue interactions. It can even directly generate product prototypes fully equipped with elements like menus, lists, forms, and buttons for rapid validation.

Como plataforma de desarrollo orientada a entornos empresariales, NetEase CodeWave combina métodos visuales con IA, permitiendo que cada paso sea automatizado por la IA mientras mantiene espacio para el diseño manual y ajustes detallados, creando así un nuevo modelo de desarrollo inteligente más controlable, estandarizado y práctico. Se lanzaron varias capacidades centrales de IA, cubriendo todo el ciclo de vida del desarrollo de aplicaciones.

items.raw_excerpt: 在医药行业，药品信息迭代日新月异，新药品种类持续扩容。与此同时，针对老年人、儿童、孕产妇等特殊人群的用药评估，因个体差异显著、药物间相互作用关系复杂，往往需投入大量时间研判潜在风险，给药师工作带来了巨大挑战。传统依赖人工经验的药学服务模式，在效率与精准度上已难以完全匹配当前临床对用药安全、高效的核心需求。 随着人工智能技术的突破，通过对临床用药数据的深度学习，AI大模型的研发和应用有望助力优化药学工作流程，提升用药服务质量，为医患双方构建更可靠的用药保障体系。10月16日，北京清华长庚医院与北京电子数智科技有限责任公司（简称“北电数智”）达成战略合作。依托北电数智“星火·医疗底座”，双方将在多个“AI+医疗”创新领域开展联合攻关，其中之一就是将共同研发中国首个药学大模型，推动药学服务更精准、更高效。 本次战略合作将深度融合北京清华长庚医院丰富的临床实践与科研经验，以及北电数智在全栈AI底座、可信数据服务和产业赋能方面的系统性优势。据了解，北京清华长庚医院是国家食品药品监督管理总局批准的“国家药物临床试验机构”，现已有30个专业获得开展药物临床试验的资质，覆盖肿瘤、心血管、神经、内分泌、肝胆胰等多个关键疾病领域，且拥有一批临床试验经验丰富的临床研究人员和管理人员。 北电数智是北京电控面向人工智能领域布局的核心产业平台，依托“1个AI底座+2大产业平台”的战略内核，构建从AI基础设施建设到产业数智化升级的全链条服务体系。其面向医疗健康领域的“星火·医疗底座”，聚焦医疗行业“医、教、研、管”四大业务领域，构建起贯通数据要素激活、模型能力强化、场景落地应用的全链条医疗数智化体系，贯通“病患-基层机构-医院”服务链路，加速AI在医疗行业深度渗透，构建精准医疗服务生态。 双方将共同研发的药学大模型，将在北京清华长庚医院率先落地应用，打通技术迭代与临床用药的闭环，帮助医药工作者提高工作效

excerpt_i18n.en: In the pharmaceutical industry, drug information evolves rapidly, and the variety of new drugs continues to expand. At the same time, medication evaluations for special populations such as the elderly, children, and pregnant women often require extensive time to assess potential risks due to significant individual differences and complex drug interactions, posing major challenges for pharmacists. Traditional pharmacy services relying on manual expertise struggle to fully meet current clinical demands for medication safety and efficiency in terms of both speed and accuracy. With breakthroughs in artificial intelligence, the development and application of large AI models, through deep learning of clinical medication data, are expected to help optimize pharmacy workflows, improve medication service quality, and build a more reliable medication protection system for both healthcare providers and patients. On October 16, Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital and Beijing Electronic Digital Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. (referred to as "BEDZ") entered into a strategic partnership. Leveraging BEDZ's "Spark·Medical Base," the two parties will collaborate on multiple "AI+healthcare" innovation areas, including jointly developing China's first large pharmacy model to make pharmacy services more precise and efficient. This strategic cooperation will deeply integrate Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital's extensive clinical practice and research experience with BEDZ's systemic strengths in full-stack AI infrastructure, trusted data services, and industry empowerment. It is understood that Beijing Tsinghua Chang Gung Hospital is a "National Drug Clinical Trial Institution" approved by the China Food and Drug Administration, with 30 specialties currently qualified to conduct drug clinical trials, covering areas such as oncology, cardiovascular, neurology, and endocrinology.
excerpt_i18n.es: En el sector farmacéutico, la información sobre medicamentos evoluciona rápidamente y las variedades de nuevos fármacos siguen expandiéndose. Al mismo tiempo, la evaluación de medicamentos para grupos especiales como ancianos, niños y embarazadas, debido a las marcadas diferencias individuales y las complejas interacciones entre fármacos, a menudo requiere invertir mucho tiempo en analizar riesgos potenciales, lo que supone un gran desafío para los farmacéuticos. El modelo tradicional de servicios farmacéuticos basado en la experiencia humana ya no puede satisfacer plenamente las necesidades actuales de seguridad y eficiencia en el uso de medicamentos en la práctica clínica. Con los avances en inteligencia artificial, mediante el aprendizaje profundo de datos clínicos de medicamentos, el desarrollo y aplicación de grandes modelos de IA tienen el potencial de optimizar los flujos de trabajo farmacéuticos, mejorar la calidad de los servicios de medicación y beneficiar tanto a médicos como a pacientes.
